name: Soybean Crush Spread (GPM) Seasonality
description: Seasonal analysis of the CBOT board crush spread (Gross Processing Margin). Computes GPM = ZL × 11/100 + ZM × 44/2000 − ZS/100 using front-month continuation prices. Shows average GPM by calendar month (bar chart), the full day-of-year seasonal curve with current 2026 overlay (line chart), and a summary table comparing today's GPM to historical norms for this time of year.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN CRUSH SPREAD (GPM) SEASONALITY
# =============================================================================
# CBOT Board Crush Formula:
#   GPM = ZL (soybean oil) × 11/100
#       + ZM (soybean meal) × 44/2000
#       − ZS (soybeans)    × 1/100
#
# ZL price: cents/lb  → ×11 lbs per bushel → /100 to convert cents→dollars
# ZM price: $/short ton → ×44 lbs per bushel → /2000 lbs per ton
# ZS price: cents/bushel → /100 to convert cents→dollars
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary table: current GPM vs historical stats for this DOY
#   2. Monthly avg GPM bar chart (12-bar seasonality)
#   3. Day-of-year line chart: historical avg vs current year (2026)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZS (primary asset via market_data_source) ---
src = market_data_source()()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Data: ZM (soybean meal) via reference_futures ---
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

# --- Data: ZL (soybean oil) via reference_futures ---
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- GPM Calculation (CBOT Board Crush, $/bushel) ---
# ZL: cents/lb × 11 lbs / 100 cents per dollar
# ZM: $/short ton × 44 lbs / 2000 lbs per ton
# ZS: cents/bushel / 100 cents per dollar
gpm = zl_cont.c * 11.0 / 100.0 + zm_cont.c * 44.0 / 2000.0 - zs_cont.c / 100.0

# --- Calendar components ---
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())
doy_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_year)(index())

# --- Split GPM into historical (all years except 2026) and current year (2026) ---
# Guard with is_valid to avoid NaN propagation in ternary
gpm_hist = gpm if (is_valid(gpm) and year_num != 2026) else 0.0 / 0.0
gpm_curr = gpm if (is_valid(gpm) and year_num == 2026) else 0.0 / 0.0

# --- Monthly label: only carry GPM value on valid bars (for monthly bar chart) ---
# Use NaN-propagation trick so label aligns with valid GPM bars
nan_flag = gpm / gpm
month_label = month_num * nan_flag

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Current GPM vs Historical Norms (order=0, first)
# =============================================================================
# Current DOY for March 18 is ~77. We use the full daily series and let
# the reporter aggregate — current GPM is the Last value of gpm_curr,
# historical stats come from gpm_hist aggregated over all history.
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='GPM: Current Level vs Historical Norms',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current (2026)', 'Historical Avg'],
        col_headers=['GPM ($/bu)', 'Historical Median'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2,
                       info='Most recent 2026 GPM in $/bushel'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2,
                       info='Most recent 2026 GPM (same as left for reference)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=2,
                       info='Historical mean GPM across all years'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2,
                       info='Historical median GPM across all years')
        ]
    ),
    category='1. GPM Seasonality',
    order=0
)(gpm_curr, gpm_curr, gpm_hist, gpm_hist)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Monthly Average GPM Bar Chart (order=1)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Is March a High or Low Point? — Avg GPM by Calendar Month',
    category='1. GPM Seasonality',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg GPM ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Avg GPM ($/bu)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(gpm, label=month_label)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Day-of-Year Seasonal Curve — Historical Avg vs 2026 (order=2)
# =============================================================================
# xy_lines with per-series agg=Mean groups by x_values (DOY) and averages
# each series across all years — historical avg collapses to one curve,
# current year collapses to the 2026 daily path indexed by DOY.
xy_lines(
    title='Where Does March Sit in the Annual Cycle? — GPM by Day of Year',
    category='1. GPM Seasonality',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Historical Avg (all years)', color=Color.Gray,
                       agg=AggregationType.Mean),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2026 (current year)', color=Color.Blue,
                       agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=77.0, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash,
                      title='Today (Mar 18)', vertical=True)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='GPM ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Day of Year',
    smooth=True,
    order=2
)(x_values=doy_num, y_values=(gpm_hist, gpm_curr))
